purpose: Released-versus-candidate regression evaluation for experienced semiconductor job matching

encoder.derivation: The encoder was run over build_job_embed_text for each corpus row in JSONL order

candidate_profile.scope: synthetic evaluation persona; not a private resume
candidate_profile.experience: Seven years in semiconductor manufacturing, quality, and transformation, including about two and a half years at manager level
evidence: Multi-site manufacturing and quality transformation across several regions
QMS, ISO 9001, CAPA, MRB, 8D, FMEA, SPC, yield improvement, and change management
Mentored a team of engineers and coordinated engineering, operations, and supplier stakeholders
unverified: Five or more years of formal people management
Direct ownership of a production department headcount
preferences: Established semiconductor employers are preferred when role fit is otherwise comparable

judging.pooling: Union of released and candidate top-k results, deduplicated before anonymization

relevance_scale.0: Wrong function, level, location, or unsupported career direction
relevance_scale.2: Plausible fit with a material gap

judging.eligibility: Evaluate the case's explicit direct-employer, Singapore, company, title, and junior constraints independently of semantic relevance
judging.seniority_fit: False when the role is clearly junior or requires materially more formal management scope than the profile supports
judging.adjudication: Use the median relevance and majority vote for boolean labels; report disagreement rather than hiding it

hard_gates: No candidate empty case when the judged pool contains eligible relevant work
Every candidate top-k result has a blinded judgment
Explicit Micron search returns only eligible Micron roles
promotion_rule.comparison: Candidate must be non-inferior to the released arm on every case and improve at least one case; no arbitrary aggregate threshold

cases.query: semiconductor manufacturing operations transformation quality leadership yield improvement
semiconductor production operations manager yield continuous improvement
quality systems QMS ISO 9001 CAPA MRB 8D FMEA semiconductor manager
semiconductor manufacturing transformation change management SPC yield
semiconductor manufacturing manager based in Batam
